blocks.prompt: V1 hook type: standard or multi-part
Multi-part: how the pieces are made
Screenshot of V1: whole window, file name and tree
V1 measurements against the rules, with a fix for any that miss

criteria.text: V1 is a whole hook in its own file, shown with its name and a readable tree

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The screenshot shows a whole hook (not a start), V1_ and the student's last name at the top, and a readable tree with no red or yellow.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A whole hook, but the tree has red or yellow, or the name does not follow V1_LASTNAME.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A sketch or a partial body, or the tree and name cannot be read.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No screenshot.

criteria.text: Every dimension is measured on the model, and every one outside a rule has a fix

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every row carries a number measured on the student's own model, and every row outside its rule says what changes and by how much.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One row has no measurement, or one row outside its rule has no fix.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The numbers repeat the rule rather than the model, or two or more rows are missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No measurements.

blocks.prompt: Which printer: X1 Carbon or H2D
Nozzle set in Bambu Studio
Filament set in Bambu Studio
Full-size weight from Bambu Studio, grams
Half-size weight from Bambu Studio, grams
Preview screenshot: the thinnest spot, weight showing
At the thinnest spot: solid walls or infill, and why it matters in a pull
The printer it is on, name or number

criteria.text: The half-size copy is set up right and printing

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The nozzle matches the printer picked, Generic ABS, and the printer it runs on is named.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Printing, but the nozzle does not match the printer or the filament is not Generic ABS.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No printer named and no settings picked.

criteria.text: Both weights are read off Bambu Studio and the full size is judged against 50.0 g

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Full-size and half-size weights from the slicer, and the full size is at or under 50.0 g, or the page's warning was acted on.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One weight is missing or is not a slicer reading.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No weights.

criteria.text: The preview shows the thinnest spot, and the line says why walls or infill matter there

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A sliced preview at the thinnest spot with the weight readable, and a sentence on walls or infill there and why it matters in a pull.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The screenshot is not at the thinnest spot or the weight is hidden, or the sentence names walls or infill with no why.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only the screenshot or only the sentence.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing.

blocks.prompt: Your call, before the pull: where will it break?
Why there?
Breaking load from the score sheet, lb
Photo of the break
Another photo of the break
What the hook did when it failed
What it did, if none of the choices fit
Where it broke
One thing V2 changes because of it
More pulls: date, version, load, where it broke

criteria.text: A call made before the pull, with a reason

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A spot picked before the pull, and a reason about where the load goes or where the hook is thinnest. A wrong call earns the same as a right one.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A spot with a reason that could fit any hook.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No spot picked.

criteria.text: The copy is pulled at the rig and the load recorded

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The breaking load from the score sheet, in pounds.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A load that is not from the rig's score sheet, or no unit.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No load.

criteria.text: The break photo is close, in focus, and shows the broken face

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: At least one photo close and in focus on the broken face.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A photo of the break that is blurry, far away, or misses the broken face.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No photo.

criteria.text: Reads the break: how it failed, where, and what V2 changes

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Picks how it failed and where, and names one change for V2 at that place, by how much.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Mode and spot picked, but the change is not tied to where it broke.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only the mode or only the spot.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing.
